title: cajanus mollis
intro: Cajanus mollis, commonly known as Pigeon Pea, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, manage diabetes, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Cajanus mollis include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive compounds present in Cajanus mollis are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been studied for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
